B's sample content is a structurally different, AIP/BC-7 governance-and-workflow invariant catalog (I-1 exactly-one-mutation-owner, I-4 registry!=authority, mechanically-enforced-vs-declared-only invariant asymmetry, the IMPLEMENTED/VERIFIED/ADOPTED/AUTHORIZED lifecycle). These are two independently-scoped catalogs from different subsystems (epistemic semantics vs workflow/governance mechanics) with no overlapping named invariants found in either sample.
p3a_pairs.what_would_make_this_wrong: A row showing one of the 17 epistemic invariants (e.g. Unknown!=False) formally registered as a numbered item (I-n) inside the AIP/BC-7 invariant-catalog, or vice versa, would establish real overlap.
